links.outcome: LLM versus junior ophthalmologists on DED classification and treatment necessity accuracy on same cases
links.effect: Treatment necessity accuracy LLMs 96-99% vs junior ophthalmologists 97%; DeepSeek-V3 classification 92% (kappa 0.80) outperformed ChatGPT-4o and juniors (71%, kappa ≈ 0.53; p < 0.01).
links.quote: For DED classification, DeepSeek-V3 achieved the highest accuracy (92%) and agreement with experts (kappa = 0.80), outperforming ChatGPT-4o and junior ophthalmologists (71%, kappa ≈ 0.53; p < 0.01).

unlisted_practices: Screening candidate LLMs with a 20-item test at a 95% accuracy threshold before case-based evaluation

screen.reason: The study evaluates LLM diagnostic and treatment performance on standardized clinical dry eye disease cases compared against junior ophthalmologists. It evaluates model accuracy and safety scores without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
